body:
I started finding research under each question instead of only sitting inside my own reasoning. For identity I started looking at personal identity, embodiment, Locke, Fuchs, affectivity and questions around body, consciousness, psychological continuity and whether identity changes when cognition or memory changes. For the AI question I looked at automation bias, agency and authorship, perspective taking toward robots and the way humans attribute experience or agency to artificial systems. For the art question I went into art therapy, emotional processing in visual art making, self expression and philosophical writing around expressing feeling.

The research started separating itself into a few areas:
- Philosophy and personhood
- Psychology and behaviour
- AI and HCI
- Art and aesthetics
- Ethics, agency and authorship
